ingredientSections.heading: Béchamel
items: ½ tsp Black Pepper, freshly ground

ingredientSections.heading: Filling
items: 200g Little Qualicum Raclette (you may substitute LQ Rathtrevor)

methodSections.heading: Béchamel
steps: Bring the milk up to heat with the bay leaf and then simmer on a very low heat for 15 minutes.
In another pan, sweat the butter and shallot over medium-low heat for 3-4 minutes. Do not allow to brown.
Add the flour, salt and, pepper. Mix well until fully incorporated creating a roux.
Remove bay leaf from milk and, half a cup at a time, add the milk to the roux. Mix well until incorporated. Do not add the next portion of milk until mixture is smooth.
Bring to a boil slowly over medium/low heat, stirring constantly. Make sure the roux does not stick to the bottom of the pot.
Simmer for 5-10 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally.
Remove from the heat. Puree with a hand immersion blender. Set aside.

methodSections.heading: Filling
steps: Grate all three cheeses and mix together. Reserve 200g for the topping.
Cook pasta according to manufacturer's instructions.
Once cooked, drain pasta in colander. Run cold water over it to stop the cooking.
In a large bowl, combine pasta and warm béchamel sauce and mix well.
Fold in the grated cheese mix. Check and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper.

methodSections.heading: Topping
steps: Mix topping ingredients together. Spread topping evenly over the pasta and sauce in the casserole dish.
Keep in fridge until ready to cook.
Cook at 180°C (350°F) until hot and the top is golden and bubbly, approximately 45-60 minutes.
